desc: Implement coordinate compression for the array A to map values to ranks 1..M.
Build a Fenwick Tree (or Segment Tree) that supports point updates (setting a value at a rank) and prefix maximum queries.
Read input, store queries, and sort them by R_i.
Iterate through the array A, updating the BIT with the LIS length ending at each A_i, and answering all queries with the current R_i by querying the prefix max up to the rank of X_i.
Print the answers in the original order of queries.
